title: Density-aware button scale and token migration: unify touch targets and contrast across modes
creator: Ava Rodriguez
description: We have drift across button sizes, touch targets, and color contrast between legacy tokens and the new token sets introduced during the last theme expansion. This ticket scopes a migration plan that unifies size tokens for three density modes, preserves accessible contrast ratios, and ensures icon-only buttons keep minimum hit areas without changing visual rhythm. Deliverables: token mapping, component updates, Figma spec, dev migration PR, and verification checklist.
context: Recent token changes (theme-v2) introduced subtle height differences for primary/secondary variants and inconsistent left/right padding on icon-only buttons. Product noticed regressions in mobile tappability and a reduced 4.5:1 contrast in some edge-theme combinations. Engineering has limited capacity to support a large refactor; prefer a migration strategy that minimizes runtime branching and relies on token fallbacks where possible.
decisions: Adopt three density profiles: comfortable (default), compact (-8% vertical scale), dense (-16% vertical scale) with explicit tokens for height, horizontal padding, and icon size.
Establish canonical token names: button.height.{density}, button.padding.x.{density}, button.icon.size.{density} to avoid parallel token sets.
Maintain a minimum recommended touch target of 40px for visual sizes by adding an invisible hitbox adjustment layer for icon-only small buttons.
Require contrast delta verification in theme builds: any token change must include wcag 2.1 AA checks for text/icon on primary/secondary/ghost surfaces.
Prefer token-level fallbacks instead of conditional component code: runtime should resolve missing density tokens to comfortable values.
Phased rollout: token merge in ds-core, storybook update, canary release for mobile flow, broad release after monitoring 2 weeks for regressions.
Migration will be accompanied by a codemod for consumer repos to update token references; engineering to own codemod and merge guidance.
tasks: Audit current button tokens and component variants across themes (Ava completed initial audit, see links).
Map legacy tokens to new canonical names and produce a migration table (deliverable: migration-table.csv).
Design Figma prototypes for all three densities focusing on rhythm with form elements and lists.
Update component spec and write new token contract in DS README.
Implement token aliases and runtime fallbacks in the component library (dev: ENG-team).
Introduce invisible hitbox wrapper for icon-only buttons to guarantee 40px tappability without altering visual size.
Add automated contrast tests to theme build pipeline and run across all published themes.
Create storybook stories for each density and run cross-browser visual regression tests (Percy/Chromatic).
Author codemod and migration guide for consumer repos; coordinate with Solutions Engineering for high-usage customers.
Ship PR, monitor telemetry and accessibility alerts for a 2-week canary window, and gather feedback from mobile QA.
acceptance_criteria: All button visual sizes in stories match Figma specs for comfortable/compact/dense.
Icon-only buttons maintain 40px tappable area on mobile while preserving visual size.
Contrast checker passes WCAG 2.1 AA for text/icon on primary, secondary, and ghost surfaces across all themes.
Migration table and codemod published with step-by-step guide; at least two consumer repos validated the codemod.
No runtime component branches required for density; missing tokens fall back safely to comfortable values.
Percy/Chromatic snapshots report no unintended layout shifts on critical pages during canary.
Review approvals from Design Lead (Ava), Accessibility Owner (Nina Shah), and ENG owner (Liam Patel).
